description: List elements, optionally filtered by category, block, period, group, state at 25 °C or a numeric property range, and sorted by a property. Without filters it lists all 118 elements in atomic-number order. Elements with no value for the range or sort property are left out.

group.description: Group (column), 1-18; lanthanides and actinides have none

locale.description: Language for names and text: en, es, fr, de, zh, pt, ja, hi, ru (default en)

max.description: Maximum value of `property` (inclusive), in its unit

min.description: Minimum value of `property` (inclusive), in its unit

phase.description: State at 25 °C, derived from the melting and boiling points

property.description: Numeric property for min/max and sorting

name: list_elements
title: List elements
